dataset: Minor Hotels — Coastal Directory Inventory (property-origin partner triage for Navier)
method: Web capability (web_search_web + web_scrape_website) over official brand directories, property pages, and Minor pipeline pages; built additively on anantara-directory-partial.json baseline. | BROWSER SWEEP: re-crawled Anantara/Avani/Oaks JS-rendered directories with real Chromium (evaluate DOM extraction) + targeted web_search/scrape confirmations; merged additively.
scope_note: Brands IN: Anantara, Avani, Tivoli, coastal Oaks, waterfront NH/NHC outliers, Elewana coastal outliers, Minor Reserve Collection coastal. Urban NH/nhow, inland Oaks apartments, Elewana safari lodges excluded. Pipeline waterfront = IN as future-BP candidates.
rules: null/unknown beats confidently-wrong; no invented properties/coords; coastal class justified by source language. Inland/desert/mountain/urban kept in inventory but coastal_relevant=false and bucketed 'inland-excluded'.
